name: PixiePocket: AI Image Maker
subtitle: AI Photo Editor
promotionalText: New: one-tap edits. Turn a selfie into a studio portrait, restore a faded old photo or become a 3D figurine. 3 free images, no subscription, ever.
description:
Turn any photo into something amazing with one tap: a studio-quality headshot, a restored old photo, a 3D figurine, an anime portrait, a royal portrait of your pet. Powered by Google's Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro. No subscription, ever.

Start with 3 free images. No sign-up required.

ONE-TAP EDITS
• Headshot: a studio portrait for LinkedIn and job applications that still looks like you
• Headshot pack: four studio headshots in one go
• Restore old photo: scratches out, colour back in
• 3D figurine: you as a collectable figure, box and all
• Natural retouch: better skin and light, no filter look
• White background: clean cutouts for listings and profiles
• Anime style, magazine cover, new outfit, new hairstyle and travel photo
• Royal pet portrait: your pet as Renaissance nobility
• Halloween costume: a spooky fancy-dress look with make-up

THEN REFINE IT BY CHAT
Ask for changes in plain words and each message edits your latest image: “make the blazer navy”, “put her in a bright office”. Or describe a brand-new picture from scratch.

SHARE THE BEFORE AND AFTER
Save results to Photos, or share a side-by-side before-and-after in one tap.

PAY PER IMAGE, NOT PER MONTH
Credits never expire. Buy a pack once and create whenever you like; bigger packs carry up to 68% bonus credits. No weekly trap, no renewals, no surprise charges.

CHOOSE YOUR ENGINE
• Nano Banana 2: fast and affordable
• Nano Banana Pro: sharper detail and text
• GPT Image, with size, quality, format and transparent-background controls

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your images are yours alone: there is no public feed. Your prompts and photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to create your images; you approve this before your first creation and can withdraw consent any time in Settings. Some requests may be declined by content moderation, and those never cost you credits.

Start anonymously, then sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub to keep your images in sync across iPhone and iPad.

whatsNew:
• One-tap edits: pick a photo and tap Headshot, Headshot pack, Restore old photo, 3D figurine, Natural retouch, White background, Anime style, Magazine cover, New outfit, New hairstyle, Travel photo, Royal pet portrait or Halloween costume.
• Real chat editing: after each result, your next message edits that image. Tap X on its thumbnail to start a fresh one.
• Nano Banana Pro joins Nano Banana 2 and GPT Image for sharper detail and text.
• New users now get 3 free images instead of 1.
• Save, Share and Before & After buttons under every result.
• The Lock Screen and Dynamic Island follow your image while it's made, show it when it's ready, and clear away once you've seen it.
• Choosing a photo no longer asks for access to your whole library, and notifications are only requested once you've made an image.
• Photos upload smaller and faster, and a request the model declines now says so clearly and costs nothing.
• PixiePocket now speaks Polish.
